system.description: Once per session, as a half action, bind a minor elemental spirit of your chosen type to your weapon; your next attack with it gains the effect. Aero: I damage and anyone struck is pushed up to 10 meters. Aqua: R damage and Proven (3). Geo: I damage and anyone struck is knocked prone (flying foes are immune to the knockdown). Repeatable, with a new element each time.
